query: select id, case when kind='pro' then (date_trunc('month',now() at time zone 'UTC') at time zone 'UTC') else coalesce(current_period_start,(date_trunc('month',now() at time zone 'UTC') at time zone 'UTC')) end as "period!", spend_cap_cents from subscriptions where user_id=$1 and kind=$2 and status='active' and (ended_at is null or ended_at>now()) and (current_period_start is null or current_period_start<=now()) and (current_period_end>now() or (kind='api' and current_period_end is null)) and (kind='pro' or card_seen_at is not null) order by created_at desc limit 1 for update
